subject: Non-resident supplier onboarding — GST withholding, invoice language, and PO activation (APAC batch)
related_account: Pacific Logistics Pty Ltd / Bharat Supplies
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@pacificlogistics.co>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@pacificlogistics.co
Date: 2026-10-07T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding — PO and tax details needed

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the warm onboarding call earlier. We're ready to accept POs from Redwood but have a couple of practical questions before the first invoice: 

1) GST handling — Pacific Logistics is an Australian entity supplying logistics services to Redwood APAC. Do you withhold any GST on payments to non‑resident suppliers, or do you rely on reverse charge / customer reporting? We quoted 10% GST on our sample invoice because that's the usual AU GST.

2) Invoice language — our operations team issues bilingual invoices (English + Mandarin) by default. Will Redwood accept a single bilingual PDF, or do you require a separate English-only invoice for AP accounting?

3) PO reference format — our AP needs the Redwood PO number in the body and in the invoice header to auto-apply. Can you confirm the PO layout you will issue so we can match it?

Attached: PL_tax-residency-certificate.pdf (tax ID + registration screenshot) and a sample bilingual invoice.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can submit the first invoice next week.

Best,
Anita Rao
Head of Finance Operations
Pacific Logistics Pty Ltd
attachments: [PL_tax-residency-certificate.pdf, PL_sample-invoice-en-zh.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@pacificlogistics.co>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — PO and tax details needed

Hi Anita — thanks for sending these over and for the clear questions. Looping in Laura (AP), Neha (Tax), and Vivek (Payments) so we can confirm specifics. Quick answers below; detailed follow-up from Neha/Laura in a separate message.

- GST / withholding: For Australia -> Redwood (US entity paying APAC costs) we generally do NOT withhold Australian GST on inbound payments to an AU supplier when the supplier charges GST. Instead, we consume the tax-inclusive invoice and Redwood AP will reconcile GST per local reporting. For Indian suppliers, there are additional withholding considerations — see Neha's note.

- Invoice language: We can accept bilingual PDFs as long as the invoice contains a clear single set of invoice identifiers (invoice number, date, GST/VAT registration number) in English text. Please make sure the invoice number and GSTIN/ABN are visible in the English section.

- PO reference format: Our system requires the PO number to appear in the invoice header and in the invoice body (line below supplier name). PO format will be RDW-AP-XXXXX. We will issue PO RDW-AP-2026-4492 once tax evidence is validated.

Neha / Laura — next steps? Anita — can you also provide your bank beneficiary details and the preferred currency for settlement (AUD / USD)? If AUD, we'll route to our AUS payment pool; if USD, it goes through our APAC USD flow which may require additional FX info.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@pacificlogistics.co>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T14:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — PO and tax details needed

Hi Anita — thanks for the certificate and sample invoice. Two quick tax notes for cross-border clarity: 

1) Australia (Pacific Logistics): If you are charging Australian GST (ABN and GST shown on the invoice), Redwood does not apply a separate withholding on the GST component. Make sure the ABN and tax invoice header follow ATO tax invoice requirements (ABN, GST amounts, subtotal/total).

2) India (Bharat Supplies / non-resident supplier case): For Indian vendors providing services to Redwood outside India, we sometimes need to consider withholding tax (TDS). If the service is deemed provided in India, Indian tax rules may require a withholding — the exact rate depends on the service type and DTAA. For any Indian vendor, please provide: tax residency certificate, PAN (if available), and a brief confirmation of where services are performed.

3) Invoice language: bilingual is fine; however, the English portion must include the invoice number, tax ID (ABN/GSTIN), invoice date, PO number, and a line-level description in English for automated mapping.

Attachments requested for AP activation: 
- Supplier bank details (signed bank details form)
- VAT/GST registration screenshot (ABN/GSTIN)
- WHT / Tax residency certificate (if invoiced from India)

Once we have the above and bank details, Laura can issue the PO and set payment terms.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Tax & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
